name: MCPJam Backend E2B fleet burn >$5/h (ground truth)
description: PAGE — owner: marcelo. The running E2B fleet is estimated to cost more than $5/hour, on two consecutive checks (~10 min sustained).

TRIAGE: | project _time, msg | take 1 — read byTemplate and runningOrgs. Many boxes on one template from one org = a runaway eval/swarm; oldestRunningAgeMin high = a leak (see the age monitor). Kill from the E2B dashboard or `e2b sandbox kill <id>`; the prod key's team is the one both Convex and the inspector use.
Source: e2b_fleet_snapshot (mcpjam-backend convex/e2bFleet.ts, every 5 min from E2B GET /v2/sandboxes). Silent until backend PR #1398 is in PROD.
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: this is E2B money in dollars, not sandbox counts. $5/h sustained = $120/day; a desktop browser box (8 vCPU/8 GiB) is ~$0.53/h, a default harness box (2 vCPU/512 MiB) ~$0.11/h, so $5/h is roughly ten desktops or forty-five harness boxes running at once — a level no legit hour has reached. Estimate uses E2B's published per-second prices (docs.e2b.dev/faq/calculate-sandbox-price).

SOURCE: `e2b_fleet_snapshot`, emitted every 5 min by mcpjam-backend `convex/e2bFleet.ts` (cron 'snapshot e2b fleet') straight from E2B's GET /v2/sandboxes under the shared team key. It is the only view that includes harness boxes, eval sandboxes AND the inspector's desktop browser sessions; `computer_concurrency_snapshot` (projectComputers rows) misses all three. Until that backend PR is in PROD this query returns no rows and the monitor stays silent.

WHY THRESHOLDS ARE PROVISIONAL: no baseline exists yet (fleet was 0 running when this was written). Re-measure after a week: | summarize max(estUsdPerHour), percentile(estUsdPerHour,95) by bin(_time,1d).
ROLLBACK: node ops/axiom-monitors/apply.mjs --delete e2b-fleet-burn --apply, or revert the file and re-apply.
